title: Even scientists can't agree on what science actually is
caption:
A new study shows researchers can’t even agree on what science means, while the public is far more uniform. That split may shape how we talk about uncertainty and the role of AI in future discoveries.

Source: Sciencedaily - Even scientists can't agree on what science actually is

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261119194541.htm
